title: Board Policy FP(LOCAL) Waiver Shares for Corrected Courtesy Rider Permit Fees, Student Transportation Services
content:
For the fee-waiver adjustment of a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit fee, the waiver share of the meal status on file is read from the student's School Nutrition Services Meal Account on the day the adjustment is figured:

| Meal status held in the School Nutrition Services Meal Account on that day | Waiver share of the meal status on file |
|---|---|
| any Free Meal Status tier: Free Meal Status (Household Application), Free Meal Status (Direct Certification), Free Meal Status (Categorical Eligibility) or Free Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | the free-meal waiver share of the fee table, 100 percent |
| Paid Meal Status, or the student has no meal account | zero |
| any Reduced-Price Meal Status tier: Reduced-Price Meal Status or Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) | the reduced-price waiver share of the fee table, 50 percent |

The tier is the one the meal account holds on the day the adjustment is figured.

## Examples (hypothetical students)

- A student whose meal account moved from Reduced-Price Meal Status to Free Meal Status (Household Application) is figured at 100 percent.
- A student who holds no meal account is figured at zero.
- A student on Reduced-Price Meal Status (Prior-Year Carryover) on the day the adjustment is figured is figured at 50 percent.
